note: Expert code is not in this repository. It lives in the agent above in the Extella market; sha = first 12 hex of sha256 of the code. Versions with in_market=false were used by earlier runs only.

experts.name: train_plan
experts.description: Feel like a train driver: the check of a trip plan written in the trip language (mode=check) and the trip itself by an accepted plan in the world of the seed (mode=run). This is the expert the recorded runs of the benchmark were played with.

experts.name: train_score
experts.description: Feel like a train driver: recomputes a trip from a human player's log of decisions with the same simulator the game runs, for the shared leaderboard.

experts.name: train_trip
experts.description: Feel like a train driver, the whole episode in one expert: mode=brief gives what the driver knows before departure and the trip language; mode=check runs the plan against the forecast and refuses it with the kilometre and the reason; mode=run drives the trip in the world of the seed and returns the score with its parts; mode=score replays a player's log for the leaderboard.
